'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Mike Richards LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Richards]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation]]
* '''Username:''' m007agent
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
